confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or current menus. Cuba has dual and dollarized pricing, limited published price data, and fast inflation, so every anchor is loose. Restaurant and bar anchors are the least certain. Accommodation is most uncertain for registered hostels and 3-star hotels, since casas particulares are common and state and private hotel rates vary widely. Cocktail (about 1.9x beer) and wine (about 2x beer) were set from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. FX is from search-result snippets of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page was not opened directly, and the 2026-10-16 figure in the snippets was not confirmed as published, so the 2026-10-15 observation is used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Caribbean basis: tourist-facing pricing in Havana compared with other Caribbean capitals that have high import costs and tourist-oriented restaurant and hotel pricing. Accommodation anchors reflect Old Havana and Vedado tourist areas in July, a shoulder period with no winter peak.
